title: Opening the book
excerpt: This journal is the other half of the portfolio — same tree mark, same quiet black, a dull royal purple instead of shine.
body:
This journal is the other half of the portfolio — same tree mark, same quiet black, a dull royal purple instead of shine.

Anyone may read. Only I write.

To add the next entry, open /studio/ in this site, unlock it with a GitHub token that can write this repo, fill in a date, a title, topics, images, and the writing, then publish. The public list, the log, and search pick it up from there.
